description: Firmware update instructions and optional re-registration on a different SSID

post_update.description: Rebuild the captive portal to activate firmware instruction reminders and SSID re-registration
post_update.notes: Required for this code change: rebuild the web image. Nginx Proxy Manager 2.17.1 is already running on the reported Pi, so npm and npm-setup do not need to be rerun just for this change. For any future NPM version/configuration change, its own commit manifest should list its required steps.

post_rollback.description: Rebuild captive-portal web image after rolling back this update
post_rollback.notes: Run in the bf-network repository on the Pi. Check any NPM changes before downgrading it.

notes: Instructions are collected per transition and displayed persistently after an update. Do not run installer again.
